Rising from No. 2 last year, Disfrutar’s roughly 30-course menu “showcases a Mediterranean identity with avant-garde flavours to deliver daring contemporary food that is truly thought-provoking,” according to the World’s 50 Best Restaurants.

Disfrutar chef-owners Oriol Castro, Eduard Xatruch and Mateu Casañas met while working at Ferran Adrià’s legendary El Bulli, which topped the World’s 50 Best Restaurants list a record five times. After El Bulli closed in 2011, the three chefs opened Compartir in Cadaqués and, in 2014, Disfrutar in Barcelona.

The restaurant offers two parallel tasting menus: Classic, which features the chefs’ favourite dishes from the past decade, and Festival, a compilation of their latest creations grounded in extensive culinary research.
Article content
The World’s 50 Best Restaurants describes the pace of meals at Disfrutar as “fast and fantastic,” with interactive elements and theatrical flourishes, such as Fear: The Prawn. To conclude the savoury courses, servers set down a pool of dry ice and instruct diners to “blindly fish into the vapour with bare hands to hunt for and retrieve perfectly cooked crustacea.”
Article content
The 2024 ranking includes restaurants from 26 countries and five continents. Six restaurants are in Spain, three of which made the top five. France and Thailand have the second-greatest representation, with four spots each, followed by Italy, Japan, Mexico and Peru, with three restaurants apiece.

Wing
(No. 20) in Hong Kong earned the Highest New Entry Award, while The Chairman (No. 26), also in Hong Kong, received the Highest Climber Award. Berlin’s
Nobelhart & Schmutzig
won the Sustainable Restaurant Award for its “brutally local” ethos and advocacy for better agricultural policies.
Article content
The votes of the 1,080-member World’s 50 Best Restaurants Academy — a group of industry experts and “well-travelled gourmets” from 27 regions worldwide — determine the list. As of 2019, restaurants can only reach the top once; past winners, such as last year’s No. 1, Central in Lima, join the “Best of the Best” list.
